objective: Test one asymmetric hysteresis interpretation of complete retained Nemotron scores; all mandatory quality/count/resource gates remain unchanged.
mechanism: Keep strong turn initiation while extending already active speakers through weak overlapping evidence, avoiding activation of weak phantom slots.
prediction: Calibration remains inside all gates, and four-speaker overlap recall reaches >=80% without DER >20%, identity confusion >5%, or count mismatch.
falsifier: Any required short gate fails; no continuity/distribution work follows.
semantics: Eight independent slots; initial inactive; score > onset activates; score < offset deactivates; equality retains previous state; 10ms native frames; exact centisecond intervals; active final frame ends at audio support. No score calibration, clipping, filtering or labels in candidate.

execution.command: node replay.mjs <repo-root> <alternative-evidence-root> calibration > <new-scratch-calibration.json>; confirmation <frozen-calibration.json> only after calibration passes; default replay compares retained results
execution.repairAllowance: One infrastructure/parity repair with a new identity; never retune the candidate after scores.
execution.resourceAccounting: Reuse exact inference time/RSS from frozen observations. Separately measure interpreter wall time and evaluator process RSS; sequential inference+interpretation wall must meet <=2x audio, maximum individual process RSS <=4GiB. Parsing/evaluator cost is descriptive, not inference.

limitations: Native aiqwk0.5 failure was already observed; aiqwk is interpretation-held-out only, not untouched or training-held-out.
Experimental NeMo/Lhotse layered runtime is not a sealed relocated production closure.
No known-person identification or word attribution is proven.
No new inference or machine-noise confirmation; inherited inference observations are one recorded run.
